title: Pin current page title, heading, greeting() and unknown-route behaviour
spec: Characterization only: add Playwright tests under e2e/ that pin what the app does on base, so later cards have a safety net. Covered: the document title and html lang of the page served by `npm run preview`; the single h1#greeting and its rendered text 'Hello, world!'; the greeting() export of src/main.ts, imported in Node with a stubbed document (typical, empty, special-character, undefined and null inputs, plus the import side effect that writes into #greeting); and unknown routes. There is no 404: the preview server's SPA fallback answers any unknown path with status 200 and the home document, and this is pinned as current behaviour, possibly a bug. Expected strings live in golden files under e2e/golden/ and are compared byte-for-byte. Tests must pass on base. Do not change src/**, index.html, config, lockfiles, .factory/** or .github/**; no new dependencies. risk_class is high because the manifest's risk_class is high (owner_approval risk_high).

criteria.text: GET / responds 200 text/html and the document title equals golden page/title.txt ('sample-web-ts')
The page has exactly one h1, id 'greeting', text equal to golden page/heading.txt ('Hello, world!')
greeting edge inputs: '' -> 'Hello, !', special characters passed through verbatim, undefined -> 'Hello, undefined!', null -> 'Hello, null!'
Importing src/main.ts queries '#greeting' once and sets its textContent to 'Hello, world!'
criteria.verified_by: e2e/greeting.spec.ts::import side effect writes greeting('world') into #greeting

criteria.text: Unknown routes (/does-not-exist, /nested/deep/path, /does-not-exist.txt) respond 200 with the same body as / (no 404)
criteria.verified_by: e2e/page.spec.ts::GET /does-not-exist responds 200 with the home document

criteria.text: Navigating to /does-not-exist renders the home page (title and greeting heading) with status 200
criteria.verified_by: e2e/page.spec.ts::navigating to an unknown route renders the home page
